Performers
Czech National Symphony Orchestra (orchestra) Documented

The Commons artist credit and the upstream FLAC artist tag agree. The filename’s parenthetical “Musopen Symphony” is not substituted for this ensemble credit. No conductor or individual player is named.

[1] [3]
Work version
Unknown Unknown

The sources identify the orchestral movement but do not name the performing edition, any revisions adopted, or the treatment of written repeats. The 1877 Simrock score is a reference for the guide, not an identified performance material.

[1] [3]
Recorded
Unknown Unknown

Commons gives 2012 as the file’s date and inception year. The upstream collection says the Kickstarter project was completed in 2012, with an added date of 28 August 2012 and public date of 29 August 2012. These establish release context, not a documented session date; the listening-page recording-date field is left blank.

[1] [2] [3]
Place
Unknown Unknown

No recording venue or city is supplied. The ensemble’s name does not establish the session location.

[1] [3]
Label
Musopen — Musopen Kickstarter Project Documented

Musopen is the documented digital-release source, and the upstream FLAC album tag reads “Musopen Kickstarter Project”. This is not evidence of a physical disc label or an original recording medium.

[1] [3]
Catalogue
Unknown Unknown

No commercial catalogue number is identified. The Internet Archive item identifier and file track number are digital collection metadata, not a verified carrier catalogue number.

[3]
Matrix, take, sides
Unknown Unknown

No matrix, take or side identification is supplied. The digital file does not establish whether any earlier carrier or session identifier existed.

[1] [3]
Transfer
Unknown Unknown

No transfer, editing or mastering engineer is identified. Neither the Commons uploader nor the Archive uploader is automatically credited as an engineer.

[1] [3]
Transfer date
Unknown Unknown

The 2012 Archive release context, 11 November 2024 Commons upload and 25 February 2026 Commons transcode completion are not established transfer dates.

[1] [3]
Processing
Upstream FLAC supplied through Musopen’s Kickstarter collection; matching FLAC on Wikimedia Commons; Commons supplies the MP3 access derivative. Documented

The upstream and Commons source-file SHA-1 values match: ee30a61715e2e142a5b1a5bf8bedab3868fb452e. This establishes the identity of the archived FLAC, not an unedited session master. Original recording medium, session bit depth, editing, pitch correction and restoration history are unestablished.

[1] [2] [3]
Composition rights
Commons identifies the composition as public domain under PD-old-100-expired. Documented

The source cites Brahms’s 1897 death and the work’s nineteenth-century publication. This is the composition rights statement; it is not being used to clear the modern sound recording or an unidentified modern edition.

[1]
Recording rights
Commons explicitly states that Musopen released this sound recording into the public domain worldwide, with an unrestricted-use fallback where dedication is not legally possible. Documented

The file’s Licensing section separates “Recording” from “Musical composition”. The recording-specific Musopen release is the eligibility basis, not the composition’s age. The upstream collection also links to the Public Domain Mark; no non-commercial restriction is stated there. This reports the source’s express release and does not independently audit contractual ownership.

[1] [3]

Johannes Brahms, Symphony No. 1 in C minor, Op. 68, II. Andante sostenuto; Czech National Symphony Orchestra. Conductor and session date unestablished. Musopen Kickstarter Project / Internet Archive, via Wikimedia Commons; explicit Musopen public-domain recording release. Rights statement
